title: L'Esclave
instructions: Sing the first line of the song, unaccompanied, at a steady pace.

content.source: Notes and words of the first line taken from the edition: The University Society, 1904, in the Mutopia Project's Public Domain transcription (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=587), squillo-lab E-004 round 3. The transcription prints no metronome mark: the tempo is its MIDI setting, written for playback and not printed. Words corrected from the extracted "Captive et peutêtre oubliée,": the source writes `peut -- être`, a syllable break inside the French word peut-être.
